name: playwright
description: Browser automation for interactive exploration and accessibility checks. Preferred for deterministic CI runs: the Playwright CLI (`npx playwright test`). Use this MCP server for live, interactive driving of a page (navigate, click, snapshot, a11y tree).

cli.note: CLI-first. Deterministic test execution in CI uses the CLI, not MCP.
cli.auth: npx playwright open <login_url>  # then save storage state

notes: Use the CLI for reproducible test execution and artifact collection (trace/video/screenshot/DOM/console/network). Use MCP for exploratory/interactive verification. Auth via config.test_environments (storage-state / cert / basic / oidc).
